verdict.rationale: The docs map the no-code UI's core objects to API equivalents. The workflow designer UI has full create/update/run/delete workflow endpoints via SDK or REST. Jobs can be triggered, monitored, downloaded and inspected for failures. Source connectors have CRUD endpoints, and partition/enrich/chunk/embed/extract jobs are callable via Python or cURL. The UI's 'Get Code' option and the MCP server further point to API-first parity. missing for 10: an explicit documented UI/API parity statement, evidence that account, user and admin settings are API-accessible, a published OpenAPI spec (probed paths returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.
